tells.label: hand on door frame glitches
tells.detail: In the early frames the person's hand rests on the white door frame, then the hand and arm disappear as the person moves behind the wall.

evidence.quote: glitches like the hand on the door frame

note.text: Readers may note that this video appears AI-generated due to glitches like the hand on the door frame. It is not real CCTV and resembles the 2016 Badaling tiger attack in a safari park, not a home. Timestamp is fake. https://www.reuters.com/article/world/woman-mauled-by-tiger-to-sue-beijing-wildlife-park-idUSKCN12E08J/ https://a-z-animals.com/articles/are-those-viral-animal-videos-real-tell-tale-signs-of-ai/
